root/archive Independence and Non-Affiliation Statement

root is an independent, unincorporated, student-led technology community based in Jordan. root/archive is a separate service from root’s community website at rootamman.com. The community and the archive operate independently of the American University of Madaba (AUM) and other educational institutions. Any institutional operation, sponsorship or official affiliation would be stated expressly.

Omar Khaldoon Jaber Tahrawi operates root/archive as an individual through root.

The archive uses university names, course titles and course codes to organize resources. It uses eligible student accounts to control who can submit. These references and sign-in arrangements do not imply university approval, sponsorship or supervision. The archive makes its own moderation and publication decisions. Permission to share a particular resource applies to that resource and does not imply institutional endorsement.

For questions or reports, email privacy@rootamman.com, with omar@rootamman.com as a backup.
